definitionZh: 基线源 CSS 属性定义了当内线级框有多个可能的基线时,如多线内块或内线弹性容器时使用的基线. 数值允许在与框的第一个基线,最后一个基线对齐或者让浏览器根据框类型自动决定之间作出选择.
sourceDefinition: The baseline-source CSS property defines which baseline to use when inline-level boxes have multiple possible baselines, such as multi-line inline blocks or inline flex containers. The values allow for choosing between aligning to the box's first baseline, last baseline, or letting the browser decide automatically based on the box type.
